description: This Java class, ModelServiceReader, is responsible for parsing XML configurations to read and construct service models (ModelService objects). It handles XML documents from URLs or resource handlers, creates service definitions with various attributes, permissions, notifications, parameters, and dependencies, and manages related metadata for the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ModelServiceReader
classes.description: A final class that reads XML service definition files to produce ModelService instances, supporting resource URLs or resource handlers.

methods.name: getModelServiceMap
methods.description: Static method to obtain a map of service names to ModelService objects from a URL source, given a delegator.

methods.name: getModelServiceMap
methods.description: Static method to obtain a map of service names to ModelService objects from a resource handler, given a delegator.

methods.name: getModelServices
methods.description: Internal method that parses the XML document and constructs ModelService objects for each service element found.

methods.name: createModelService
methods.description: Creates a ModelService instance from an XML 'service' element, reading its attributes and nested configurations.
